# Temple Scroll Column 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 10 | **Condition:** Fragmentary; Festival calendar concludes

---

**10:1** [...] on-the-fifth [day] Gad and-Asher [...]

**10:2** [...] on-the-sixth [day] Dan and-Naphtali [...]

**10:3** [...] this [is] the-day of-the-wood-offering [...]

**10:4** [...] a-statute of-eternity for-your-generations [...]

**10:5** [...] in-all your-dwelling-places before the-LORD [...]

**10:6** [...] and-they-shall-praise the-LORD their-God [...]

**10:7** [...] who-placed them in-the-land [...]

**10:8** [...] after these-days [...] the-memorial of-the-day [...]

**10:9** [...] the-first day of-the-seventh month [...]

**10:10** [...] a-memorial of-trumpet-blast [...] a-holy convocation [...]

**10:11** [...] and-you-shall-offer a-burnt-offering [...] an-offering-by-fire of-a-pleasing-aroma to-the-LORD [...]

**10:12** [...] one young-bull [...] one ram [...] seven he-lambs sons-of-a-year [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 10 concludes the Wood Offering Festival and transitions to the Memorial of Trumpet Blasts (yom ha-zikkaron teru'ah) on the first day of the seventh month (cf. Lev 23:24, Num 29:1). Lines 1-5 complete the wood offering legislation with a closing formula. Lines 6-7 include a praise formula acknowledging God's gift of the land. Lines 8-12 begin the autumn festival calendar with the trumpet memorial and its burnt offering roster.*
